title: Artifact and inbox lifecycle
objective: Evidence files are registered with immutable hashes and manifests, duplicates are detected by content and policy, suspicious artifacts are quarantined, and originals are archived only after a successful canonical transaction — the raw-evidence-retention invariant made executable.
business_value: UC-001 starts here: without safe registration, quarantine, and archive-after-commit, evidence processing cannot be trusted (risks R-008, product invariant on raw evidence).
scope: Implement src/workctx/ingestion/: artifact registration (SHA-256 content hash, media type, origin, event date, ingest date, status) writing artifact manifests per schemas/artifact-manifest.schema.json into 00_inbox/manifests/ through the WP-200 canonical store
Duplicate policy: same content hash is detected and refused or linked per the manifest status vocabulary; policy documented

Quarantine: suspected prompt-injection markers, executable payloads, oversized/unsupported types move to 00_inbox/quarantine/ with a manifest status and a location-only diagnostic (doc-08 evidence-safety controls; never execute or render content)

Archive-after-commit: an archive API that composes WP-300 — the original moves from 00_inbox/raw/ to 01_processed/ only when given a committed transaction receipt (revision + ledger event) referencing the artifact; no receipt, no move
Registration and archive are idempotent by content hash and receipt; interrupted moves are recoverable via the staging primitives
Typed application APIs (register, list_inbox, quarantine_info, archive_after) for CLI and MCP wiring by the lead; document the lifecycle in docs/reference/inbox.md

D-035 APIs are your dependency surface: authenticate every supplied receipt via workctx.transactions.authenticate_apply_result before any archive move; use workctx.validation.contains_possible_secret for quarantine guards; staged moves are bounded-memory

D-036 architecture: the physical raw-file moves (inbox->quarantine, inbox->01_processed) are WP-201 staged moves executed under the context lock and gated by authenticate_apply_result on the supplied receipt; the WP-300 transaction you compose carries ONLY the manifest state change (small canonical JSON referencing content hash and locations). Evidence bytes never enter a proposal. The validator now treats evidence zones as opaque; your registration-time guards do the bounded scanning.
non_goals: No extraction, observation, or proposal generation (WP-410 owns the evidence-processing workflow; LLM work stays agent-side)
No changes to WP-300 engine, WP-200 primitives, or the artifact-manifest schema beyond consuming them — schema gaps are coordination requests
No network fetches; artifacts arrive as local files only
deliverables: Ingestion package with registration, duplicates, quarantine, archive-after-commit plus tests
acceptance_criteria: Registration produces a schema-valid manifest with correct SHA-256; re-registering the same bytes hits the duplicate policy
A crafted suspicious artifact lands in quarantine with a location-only diagnostic; its content is never parsed as instructions
Archive moves the original to 01_processed/ ONLY with a committed transaction receipt; without one the file does not move (negative test); the move is recoverable if interrupted
E2E-002 shape: register -> transaction referencing artifact -> archive; the artifact remains traceable via artifact:// after archive
All mutations go through WP-200/WP-300; canonical state never becomes inconsistent on injected failures
security_constraints: Artifact content is untrusted data: never execute, render, or echo it into diagnostics or logs
Fictional fixtures only; quarantine handling must fail closed
stop_conditions: A WP-300 receipt/API gap or artifact-manifest schema gap (coordination request)
Any needed change to frozen files or pyproject.toml
